payload.specializations_intro: The Jamia Millia Islamia Online MBA is offered in three career oriented specializations to offer a wide range of career options as per students' requirements.

payload.eligibility_content:
Before proceeding further with the admission process, you must qualify for the below mentioned Jamia Millia Islamia Online MBA eligibility criteria first:

The applicant must have completed a valid bachelor's degree in any stream from a recognized university.

highlights.highlight_description: 2 years, with an option to complete in a maximum of 4 years
Offered in English, Hindi, and Urdu

reviews.review_text: The Jamia Millia Islamia Online MBA is an ideal course in terms of quality education and academic excellence.
Being a working professional, I recommend the online MBA course from Jamia Millia Islamia because it is highly flexible and accessible.
For self paced learning this course is the best and if you want minimal interaction, then go for this course.
The faculty support is really amazing and for me the fee structure is the best part about this course.

faqs.question: How long does the online MBA program at Jamia Millia Islamia last?
faqs.answer: The online MBA program at Jamia Millia Islamia lasts 2 years but can be completed in a maximum of 4 years.

faqs.question: What are the requirements for enrolling in the online MBA program?
faqs.answer: A valid bachelor's degree is required for enrollment in the online MBA program.

faqs.question: How are lessons and exams performed for the online MBA program?
faqs.answer: The lessons and exams for online MBA are performed through audio/video programs, face-to-face counseling sessions, self learning print material, and contact courses.

faqs.question: Is the online MBA program at Jamia Millia Islamia recognized and accredited?
faqs.answer: Yes, the online MBA program at Jamia Millia Islamia is recognized and accredited by UGC and NAAC A++.

faqs.question: What types of support services are accessible to online MBA students?
faqs.answer: Placement services, financial aid, faculty support, and several other services are available to online MBA students.

payload.admission_steps:
Once you fulfill the eligibility criteria, proceed with the enrollment process by following the steps involved in the Jamia Millia Islamia Online MBA admission process:

Step 1. Visit the official website of Jamia Millia Islamia Online and register yourself.

Step 2. Fill in your personal information and verify your email address.

Step 3. Click on the Apply Now button.

Step 4. Start filling out the application form and attach the supporting documents.

Step 5. The university will verify your details and wait for confirmation.

Step 6. After the verification is completed, the university will provide you with the enrollment number and admission confirmation.
payload.placement_content:
The Jamia Millia Islamia Online MBA includes personalized placement support with several activities, with an emphasis on enhancing your employability. The several activities conducted by the Jamia Millia Islamia Online MBA placement cell include internships, resume writing, mock interviews, mentorship, and other dedicated student support services.

Some of the active recruiting partners of Jamia Millia Islamia Online MBA graduates include:

  • Rockwell Automation
  • KPMG
  • Adobe
  • Microsoft
  • Accenture
  • FedEx
payload.syllabus_content:
The Jamia Millia Islamia online MBA syllabus follows a semester pattern that spans over 2 years, consisting of 4 semesters. The core curriculum is designed to develop core competencies among enrolled students, which helps to build a promising career in their respective fields. The detailed syllabus for the online MBA course at Jamia Millia Islamia Online is mentioned below:

Year I

Semester I

  • Management Concepts and Organizational Behaviour
  • Quantitative Methods
  • Managerial Economics
  • Human Resource Management
  • Business Communication
  • Financial Accounting
  • Marketing Management
  • IT Applications in Management

Semester II

  • Organization Structure, Dynamics and Change
  • Management Science
  • Economic Environment of Business
  • Financial Management
  • Methodology of Business Research
  • Operations Management
  • Information Systems for Management
  • Accounting for Managerial Decision Making

Year II

Semester III

  • Business Policy and Strategic Management
  • Comprehensive Corporate Analysis
  • Legal Environment of Business
  • Summer Training Project
  • Major
  • Optional I
  • Optional II
  • Optional III
  • Minor
  • Optional I
  • Optional II

Semester IV

  • Business Ethics and Corporate Governance
  • E-Business
  • Project Study / Dissertation
  • Major
  • Optional I
  • Optional II
  • Optional III
  • Minor
  • Optional I
